explication: slime is an LLM post-training framework centered on a shared RL loop: prompts or custom generation workflows produce rollouts, reward and verifier results are attached, samples enter the rollout data path, and Megatron trains on them before updated weights are synchronized to SGLang. The README also documents agent/environment interaction, asynchronous rollout, SGLang deployment options, and checkpoint/model conversion. Edges reflect README-described flow and sampled rollout/engine code; unsampled internals are represented only where the tree and README support the subsystem.
